Will the AI act on its own?

AI can investigate, propose analyses and plans, and perform specifically approved steps. People remain accountable for decisions. Permissions and review points are agreed in advance, and any expansion needs a separate decision.
Can work continue while our team is offline?

Selected workflows can be configured to analyze incoming requests, explore options, and prepare outputs outside office hours. Work that needs human approval waits for a reviewer. Availability depends on the agreed setup and connected services; operating hours and failure handling are part of the pilot scope.
What if the pilot does not help?
That is a useful result. The review should make it clear where evidence, usefulness, quality, coverage, or effort falls short, so you can decide whether to adjust the approach or stop.
